prompts.prompt:
Create a polished professional Japanese PC game UI concept SCREEN, 16:9 landscape, high-resolution. Match REFERENCE IMAGE 1 the event proposal's design system: refined black enamel, smoke glass recessed faces, very thin titanium highlights and close contact shadows, warm ivory active plates, restrained vermilion markers, muted purple madness, elegant Japanese heading and very legible clean sans Japanese functional text. Contemporary developed hell with atmospheric modern concrete architecture, red ambient accents, no feudal Japanese scenery, no brass baroque thorn borders, no generic blue hologram sci-fi cockpit. Rich UI material depth but thin precise components and calm readable surfaces. All three companion screens use SAME global frame: thin top navigation strip with left floor "第1層" and stage breadcrumbs 「編成 / 抽選 / 探索」 (only current stage highlighted), right 「塔片 0」 and menu icon. Bottom persistent thin status band 「共有HP 1000 / 1000」 ivory full inset HP bar, 「狂気 0 / 1000」 empty muted purple bar, three small portrait thumbnails ALICE ELLEN LUNA with Japanese names 「アリス」「エレン」「ルナ」 and 「信頼 0」. These are sample display values. No giant title logo or informational paragraphs. No decorative character portraits occluding controls. Whole screen uses spacious composition with readable important text, sufficient margins, hierarchy. Reference 2 supplies FUNCTION AND CONTENT, not obsolete look. No lorem ipsum or fake microtext, no annotations outside game.
SCREEN 1 ROULETTE BUILD. Main title top left 「記憶を編む」 subtitle 「欠片を配置して、3つの記憶の列を組みます。」. Three-column workspace with about 28% left inventory, 40% center edit board, 28% right odds, comfortable gutters. Main visual is beautiful tactile 3 columns x EXACTLY 6 rows = 18-cell modular grid, no extra row, no extra column, squared sockets not mobile emoji tiles. Thin dark crafted chassis and recessed sockets. Each cell has a custom restrained engraved silver-white glyph backed by muted semantic tint, labels as necessary; six types combat crossed blades, event folded message/window (NOT Japanese scroll), rest medical cross, treasure case, shop coin, danger warning. A sample valid board has exact rows: battle battle battle / event event event / event event event / battle rest shop / event event event / battle battle battle. All cells same size, elegant engraved type glyphs, subtle controlled tiny emission, no colorful cartoon emoji icons. Above grid column markers 「一の列」「二の列」「三の列」. Under grid per-column small check 「戦闘 3/2」「戦闘 2/2」「戦闘 2/2」 with check icons, explanatory caption 「各列に戦闘2マス以上」.
Left heading 「記憶の欠片」, compact 6-7 inventory rows each shows own piece mini silhouette of linked tiles rather than randomly scattered glyphs: 「横一・戦闘」 3 horizontal blade cells, label 「配置済み」; 「縦一・戦闘」 3 vertical cells mini icon, 「残り1」; 「L字・休息」 L-shaped mini medical cross cells 「残り2」; 「L字・宝箱」 L-shaped case cells 「残り1」; 「横一・ショップ」 three horizontal coin glyphs 「残り2」; 「横一・イベント」 three message glyphs 「配置済み」; bottom locked small strip 「第2層で解放」. Dark text-readable row faces, just selected row ivory top-lip and thin red focus marker. No unnecessary long descriptions.
Right panel heading 「列ごとの出現率」. Three compact column summaries aligned consistently:
「一の列」 「戦闘 50.0%」「イベント 50.0%」;
「二の列」 「戦闘 33.3%」「休息 16.7%」「イベント 50.0%」;
「三の列」 「戦闘 33.3%」「ショップ 16.7%」「イベント 50.0%」.
Use short muted segmented bars plus aligned labels, not big pie charts, no untrue data. Below heading 「成立する主な役」 only two illustrative nonzero odds 「戦闘 ×3  5.56%」「イベント ×3  12.50%」, and quiet link 「役をすべて見る」. Do not invent outcomes or benefits.
Lower edit toolbar beneath central board, above global footer: compact inset tools 「リスピン 残り2」「ずらし 残り1」 and three small empty sockets kept for reference functions. Right main CTA ivory enamel 「この記憶で進む」 sublabel 「確定して抽選へ」. No full-screen ornamental frames, no wall of tiny probabilities. Background faint modern afterlife memory archive, blurred dark minimal. Product looks like a carefully designed tactile strategy editor in the SAME game as event image.

SCREEN 2 DRAW / ROULETTE. Title 「記憶の抽選」 subtitle 「中央の横1列が、この層の道になります。」. Exactly three substantial vertical reels in one cohesive beautiful dark enamel machine central screen (not web form controls), same three-column spacing and type glyphs as a grid editor. Three visible symbol faces per reel, with partial top/bottom fade to imply cylindrical motion. Central winning row highlighted by a narrow red horizontal index line and bright ivory window-lip, no huge blinding glow. This is a mid-resolution frame: first reel stopped on combat, second stopped on event, third still rotating with subtle vertical blur only on its symbols. Top labels 「一の列」「二の列」「三の列」. Small status beneath each 「確定」「確定」「抽選中」. First reel center silver crossed blades, second center silver folded message/window glyph, third center slightly blurred message glyph, not random emoji. Reels occupy ~55% width and ~55% height, mechanically plausible subtle inset shadow and lip catches, no bulky armor.
Left small calm compact panel 「主な役」 with visible pictograms and just 「戦闘 ×3  5.56%」「イベント ×3  12.50%」 then 「役の詳細」 small disclosure. Large empty wall of zero probabilities removed. Below a subtle selected-row note 「抽選は中央の1列で判定」.
Right narrow area simple stage readout 「1　回転」「2　左から停止」「3　道が確定」 with stage2 currently red indicator, not a giant tutorial text box. Beneath, compact preview of three little output sockets: combat / event / empty; caption 「確定したマス」. Fourth fixed outlined tile separate 「4マス目：強敵」 with lock glyph and red edge; do not imply fourth reel or new random result.
Under machine a focused understated dark main status/disabled control 「抽選中…」; small secondary 「演出をスキップ」 at lower right and quiet 「リールを組み替える」 visible disabled during spin, no enabled START while spinning. Starting screen would use same area for 「スタート」 but do NOT display both in this snapshot.
Keep global footer. Background desaturated contemporary hell transit hall with subtle red lights, no character art taking focus. This should feel like an exciting premium instrument resolving a strategy choice, not bright casino slot advertising or pachinko neon. Emphasize flow of a selected central 3-symbol row becoming route cards; no full route duplicate on this screen.

SCREEN 3 FLOOR ROUTE. Title 「第1層 — 記憶の路」 with smaller subtitle 「4マス目は固定：強敵」. Beautiful FOUR large upright illustrated cards across center, evenly aligned vertical rectangles with slight deliberate stagger only 6px max; no tilted distorted card art, no stretched character faces. Exactly 4 cards, not branching map. Fine black-enamel border with a little titanium upper highlight, restrained engraved edge, art richly integrated; no baroque thorn frames, no giant opaque gray rectangle behind active card. Top above cards clear numbers 「01」「02」「03」「04」 linked by a thin progression line with nodes. First card selected current location, second/third upcoming, fourth fixed strong enemy. Labels fully contained in top tabs and bottom text plates, do not overlap frame or hang under borders.
Card1 「戦闘」 illustration original black-haired anime sword jailer and purple-haired horned halberd jailer in contemporary black/ivory outfits confronting shadows in modern hell concrete transit hall; tasteful cinematic anime, no huge sexualized pose. Current-location ivory bottom plate with small red pointer, text 「現在地」 and action button 「進む」. Only small precise warm edge light near focus, no broad orange glow flooding background.
Card2 「イベント」 illustration pale-haired jailer noticing a small mysterious dropped case in dim modern passage, blue-gray light, readable.
Card3 「イベント」 a DIFFERENT scene of a modern afterlife archive room with silhouetted clerk and red lifts, do not repeat same exact artwork as card2. This alternate art is illustrative only.
Card4 「強敵」 tall ominous faceless modern overcoat enemy with black obsidian mask and red slit inside monumental contemporary hell building. Dark vermilion art, small lock / tag 「固定」 at top. Card2-4 bottom statuses 「未到達」 with lighter art than fully grayed-out disabled content, visually cannot click ahead.
Above first card or below title a small selected summary 「次のマス：戦闘」, do not add invented enemy stats or unconfirmed rewards. Under cards one concise character comment strip with small portrait and text 「アリス：まずは目の前の相手から。」, dialogue is illustrative. Clear global bottom status persists, consistent with other screens and event image. Background quiet dark modern hell infrastructure, UI and card art carry appeal. Preserve the reference image's attractive large illustrated four-card idea while fixing hierarchy and text placement. Actual in-game SCREEN, no artbook callouts.
